description: Turn iterative calculation on or off for a session and recalculate. Needed for circular models (e.g. development pro formas where loan size depends on cost, which includes the loan's interest and fees): with it on, set_inputs re-converges the loop on every call. Saved with the session's next commit (restore_session to an earlier commit rolls it back) and written to the workbook, so an exported xlsx iterates in Excel too. Returns {calc, recalc}: the settings now in force and whether the model converged.

iterative.description: Enable iterative calculation (Excel: Enable iterative calculation)

max_change.description: Converged once no value moves more than this (Excel default 0.001)

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: set_calc_settings
title: Set calc settings
